items.review_note: No UI or API endpoint specified to observe order total and authorised amount; unclear how tester would compare values.
No observable behavior or system output defined to verify uniqueness and sequential order number generation.
No UI state or status field defined to observe order status as 'Pending' or transition upon payment authorisation or Finance confirmation.
No UI behavior defined for stock decrement or restoration; unclear how tester would observe stock changes.

cases.scenario_name: Guest sees checkout options when not logged in
cases.precondition: User is on the cart page with items and is not authenticated
cases.expected_result: The screen displays three options: 'Checkout as Guest', 'Register', and 'Log in'

cases.scenario_name: Authenticated user does not see guest checkout options
cases.precondition: User is logged in as a registered customer
cases.expected_result: The screen does not display 'Checkout as Guest', 'Register', or 'Log in' options

cases.scenario_name: Registered customer skips identity step and sees saved addresses
cases.precondition: User is logged in and has at least one saved address in their profile
cases.expected_result: The identity step (login/register/guest) is skipped and the user is taken directly to the address selection or entry screen with saved addresses displayed

cases.scenario_name: Guest user does not skip identity step
cases.precondition: User is not logged in and has no session
cases.expected_result: The user sees the identity step with options: 'Checkout as Guest', 'Register', or 'Log in'

cases.scenario_name: Cart contents remain locked for price during checkout
cases.precondition: User has items in cart and has proceeded to checkout
actions: Attempt to change cart quantity or remove item via checkout page controls
Observe if cart modification is possible
cases.expected_result: No option to modify cart contents (quantity, remove item) is available on the checkout page

cases.scenario_name: User can modify cart during checkout
cases.precondition: User has items in cart and has proceeded to checkout
actions: Attempt to change cart quantity or remove item via checkout page controls
Observe if cart modification is possible
cases.expected_result: The user is able to modify cart contents (e.g., change quantity, remove item) from the checkout page

cases.scenario_name: User can proceed with all required billing fields filled
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
cases.expected_result: The form accepts the input and allows progression to the next step without validation errors

cases.scenario_name: User cannot proceed when a required billing field is missing
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
cases.expected_result: The form blocks progression and displays an inline validation error for the missing ZIP/postal code field

cases.scenario_name: Valid email and phone number are accepted
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
cases.expected_result: The form accepts the email and phone input and allows progression without format validation errors

cases.scenario_name: Invalid email format is rejected
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
cases.expected_result: The form blocks progression and displays an inline validation error indicating the email is invalid

cases.scenario_name: Phone number with invalid characters is rejected
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
cases.expected_result: The form blocks progression and displays an inline validation error indicating the phone contains invalid characters

cases.scenario_name: Phone number at minimum length (6 characters) is accepted
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
cases.expected_result: The form accepts the phone number and allows progression without validation errors

cases.scenario_name: Phone number at maximum length (20 characters) is accepted
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
cases.expected_result: The form accepts the phone number and allows progression without validation errors

cases.scenario_name: Phone number below minimum length (5 characters) is rejected
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
cases.expected_result: The form blocks progression and displays an inline validation error indicating the phone number is too short

cases.scenario_name: Phone number above maximum length (21 characters) is rejected
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
cases.expected_result: The form blocks progression and displays an inline validation error indicating the phone number is too long

cases.scenario_name: All required fields filled results in no inline errors
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
actions: Move focus away from each field after entry
cases.expected_result: No inline error messages appear for any required field after data entry and focus loss

cases.scenario_name: Missing city field shows inline message 'City is required'
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
actions: Move focus away from the city field
cases.expected_result: An inline message appears near the city field stating 'City is required'

cases.scenario_name: Missing email field shows inline message 'Email is required'
cases.precondition: User is on the billing address section of checkout
actions: Move focus away from the email field
cases.expected_result: An inline message appears near the email field stating 'Email is required'

cases.scenario_name: Registered customer selects a saved billing address
cases.sub_module: Billing address selection from saved list
cases.precondition: Registered customer is logged in and has at least one saved billing address in their profile
cases.data: Customer selects the first saved address from the dropdown list
actions: Navigate to checkout billing address section
Select the first saved address from the list
cases.expected_result: The selected saved billing address is populated in the billing address fields and the form proceeds to the next step without validation errors

cases.scenario_name: Registered customer attempts to proceed without selecting a billing address
cases.precondition: Registered customer is logged in and has saved addresses but no address is selected
cases.data: No billing address selected; form fields remain empty or unchanged
actions: Navigate to checkout billing address section
cases.expected_result: The system prevents progression and displays an inline validation error indicating that a billing address must be selected

cases.scenario_name: Customer proceeds with 'Ship to the same address' checkbox ticked
cases.precondition: Customer is in checkout flow, has entered a valid billing address, and the 'Ship to the same address' checkbox is present and ticked by default
cases.data: Billing address: 123 Main St, Anytown, USA; checkbox remains ticked
actions: Verify 'Ship to the same address' checkbox is ticked by default
cases.expected_result: The shipping address fields are automatically populated with the billing address values and the user is not required to manually enter shipping details

cases.scenario_name: Customer attempts to skip shipping address entry when 'Ship to the same address' is unticked
cases.sub_module: Shipping address requirement when checkbox is unticked
cases.precondition: Customer is in checkout flow, has entered a valid billing address, and has manually unticked the 'Ship to the same address' checkbox
cases.data: Billing address entered; 'Ship to the same address' checkbox unticked; shipping address fields empty
actions: Untick the 'Ship to the same address' checkbox
Click 'Continue' to shipping step without entering shipping address
cases.expected_result: The system prevents progression to the next step and displays an inline validation error indicating that shipping address is required

cases.scenario_name: Customer selects United States and is required to select a state
cases.sub_module: State selection mandatory for countries with states
cases.precondition: Customer is entering a new address and has selected 'United States' as the country
cases.data: Country: United States; State: initially unselected
actions: Select 'United States' from the country dropdown
Attempt to proceed to next field or submit
cases.expected_result: The system prevents progression and displays an inline validation error indicating that state is required when United States is selected

cases.scenario_name: Customer selects Canada and is not required to select a state/province
cases.sub_module: State/province requirement based on country selection
cases.precondition: Customer is entering a new address and has selected 'Canada' as the country
cases.data: Country: Canada; Province: initially unselected
actions: Attempt to proceed to next field or submit
cases.expected_result: The system allows progression without requiring province/state selection, as Canada may not enforce it in this context (per BRD silence on non-US countries)

cases.scenario_name: Shipping address enforces same field rules as billing address
cases.sub_module: Field rule consistency between billing and shipping address
cases.precondition: Customer has entered a valid billing address and is now entering a shipping address (either manually or via 'Ship to same address')
cases.data: Shipping address fields: street, city, state, country, postal code — all using same validation as billing
actions: Enter a valid billing address with all required fields
Enter a shipping address using the same format and validation rules (e.g., same character limits, required fields, format)
cases.expected_result: The shipping address accepts input only if it conforms to the same field-level rules (e.g., required fields, max length, format) as the billing address, and rejects invalid input with identical error messages

cases.scenario_name: Shipping address rejects invalid input using same rules as billing
cases.sub_module: Validation rule inheritance for shipping address
cases.precondition: Customer is in shipping address section and knows that billing address rejects special characters in street field
cases.data: Shipping street field: '123@ Main St' (invalid special character)
actions: Enter '123@ Main St' in the street field
cases.expected_result: The system rejects the input with the same validation error message used for billing address (e.g., 'Special characters not allowed in street field')

cases.scenario_name: Customer sees all three shipping methods with correct labels and prices
cases.precondition: Customer is in the shipping method selection step of checkout
cases.data: Methods: Ground (5–7 business days), Next Day Air, 2nd Day Air; each with associated price shown
actions: Observe the list of available shipping methods
cases.expected_result: Exactly three shipping methods are displayed: Ground (5–7 business days), Next Day Air, and 2nd Day Air, each with its corresponding price clearly shown next to the label

cases.scenario_name: System does not display any shipping method not listed in BRD-3.2
cases.precondition: Customer is in shipping method selection step
cases.data: No additional methods (e.g., Express, Overnight, Economy) are present
actions: Scan the list of available shipping methods
cases.expected_result: Only the three specified methods (Ground, Next Day Air, 2nd Day Air) are present; no extra or undefined shipping methods are displayed

cases.scenario_name: Ground shipping is pre-selected and exactly one method can be chosen
cases.precondition: Customer is in the shipping method selection step; no prior selection has been made
cases.data: Ground method is pre-selected; Next Day Air and 2nd Day Air are unselected
actions: Observe initial state of radio buttons or selection controls
cases.expected_result: The Ground shipping method is automatically selected (pre-selected) on page load, and the user cannot select more than one method at a time (mutually exclusive selection)

cases.scenario_name: Customer attempts to select more than one shipping method
cases.precondition: Customer is in shipping method selection step; Ground is pre-selected
cases.data: Attempt to select both Ground and Next Day Air
actions: Click to select Next Day Air while Ground remains selected
cases.expected_result: Selecting a second method automatically deselects the previously selected method, ensuring only one shipping method is ever selected at any time

cases.scenario_name: Order over $100.00 qualifies for free Ground shipping
cases.precondition: Customer has added items to cart totaling more than $100.00 and is at shipping method selection
cases.data: Cart total: $100.01; Shipping method: Ground
cases.expected_result: The shipping cost for Ground is displayed as $0.00 (free) in the order summary, and no shipping charge is applied to the total

cases.scenario_name: Order under $100.00 does not qualify for free Ground shipping
cases.precondition: Customer has added items to cart totaling less than $100.00 and is at shipping method selection
cases.data: Cart total: $99.99; Shipping method: Ground
cases.expected_result: The shipping cost for Ground is displayed as a non-zero value (e.g., $5.99 or similar) in the order summary, and the standard shipping charge is applied to the total

cases.scenario_name: Order exactly $100.00 does not qualify for free Ground shipping
cases.precondition: Customer has added items to cart totaling exactly $100.00 and is at shipping method selection
cases.data: Cart total: $100.00; Shipping method: Ground
cases.expected_result: The shipping cost for Ground is displayed as a non-zero value (standard charge) in the order summary, confirming that the threshold is 'over 100.00' and not '100.00 or more'

cases.scenario_name: Customer selects one valid payment method and proceeds
cases.precondition: Customer is in the payment method selection step of checkout
cases.data: Customer selects 'Credit Card' as payment method
actions: Select one payment method (e.g., Credit Card)
cases.expected_result: The system accepts the selection and allows progression to the next step (e.g., order review or confirmation) without validation error

cases.scenario_name: Customer attempts to proceed without selecting any payment method
cases.precondition: Customer is in payment method selection step; no payment method is selected
cases.data: No payment method selected; all options unselected
actions: Ensure no payment method is selected
cases.expected_result: The system prevents progression and displays an inline validation error indicating that a payment method must be selected

cases.scenario_name: COD payment method displays applicable fee information message
cases.precondition: Customer is in payment method selection and has selected 'Cash on Delivery' (COD)
cases.data: COD selected; additional fee: $7.00
actions: Observe the interface for informational messages
cases.expected_result: An information message is displayed near the COD option stating that an additional fee of $7.00 applies (e.g., 'COD: +$7.00 fee')

cases.scenario_name: COD fee message is not displayed when another payment method is selected
cases.precondition: Customer is in payment method selection and has selected a non-COD method (e.g., Credit Card)
cases.data: Credit Card selected; COD not selected
actions: Select a payment method other than COD (e.g., Credit Card)
Observe the interface for COD-related messages
cases.expected_result: No information message about a $7.00 COD fee is displayed, as the fee disclosure is only shown when COD is selected

cases.scenario_name: Check/Money Order payment method displays mailing address and indicates order hold
cases.sub_module: Check/Money Order payment instructions and order status
cases.precondition: Customer is in payment method selection and has selected 'Check / Money Order'
cases.data: Check/Money Order selected; mailing address displayed; order status indicated as held
actions: Observe the interface for displayed information
cases.expected_result: The system displays a clear mailing address where the check or money order should be sent (e.g., 'Please mail payment to: 123 Finance Ave, Paytown, PA 12345') and an accompanying message stating that the order will be held until payment is received (e.g., 'Order held pending payment receipt')

cases.scenario_name: Check/Money Order mailing address and hold message are not displayed when another method is selected
cases.precondition: Customer is in payment method selection and has selected a non-Check/Money Order method (e.g., Credit Card)
cases.data: Credit Card selected; Check/Money Order not selected
actions: Select a payment method other than Check/Money Order (e.g., Credit Card)
Observe the interface for Check/Money Order-related messages
cases.expected_result: No mailing address or 'order held until payment received' message is displayed, as this information is only shown when Check/Money Order is selected
